original_test_intent: Verify every required ambient-temperature sensor's identity, location, description, value, state and thresholds consistently across IB SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web against the approved specification.
original_method: Map each inlet/outlet/chassis/rack ambient probe to a stable record, document airflow and environmental state, retain complete aligned IB/OOB inventories and Web pages, normalize temperature units/rounding/freshness and compare with the specification and, where required, a calibrated colocated reference without stimulating temperature.
manual_activity: The thermal owner supplies probe locations/spec/tolerance and resolves criteria 3–23; an operator records airflow/environment and complete Web evidence, then the owner decides the result.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/chassis/rack identity and physical location of each ambient probe
Authoritative sensor spec, expected population, units, range, thresholds, accuracy and freshness
Definition of ambient boundary: inlet, outlet, chassis internal or rack/room
Current workload, fan/airflow and environmental stabilization conditions
Calibrated reference instrument/location and tolerance if accuracy comparison is required
Secure access, Web capture, timing/cache/rounding rules and criteria 3–23 disposition
safety_requirements: Keep collection passive; do not heat, cool, obstruct airflow or change fan/thermal policy
Protect credentials and retain full outputs before TEMP_AMBIENT filtering
Bind each sensor to physical location; reject the test title as a literal record
Do not truncate or clear thermal/BMC/host logs
Stop on ambiguous mapping, missing/duplicate/stale value, out-of-range temperature or thermal alarm
agent_execution_scope: Verify unique source and collect complete read-only IB/OOB inventories
Apply owner-approved physical probe mapping and normalize units/state/thresholds
Correlate environment, airflow, workload and optional reference readings and prepare Web parity
Perform no thermal stimulus, fan control, threshold write, criteria invention or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve ambient boundary, probe population/mapping, expected values and reference tolerance
Resolve the criteria-number gap and omitted ambient checks
Review all probes and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool is relevant, but `sensor get 'Sensor Check - TEMP_AMBIENT'` invents a record and OOB-only/truncated evidence omits complete IB/Web/location coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely retain full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, map every approved ambient probe, capture complete Web rows and compare aligned passive environmental evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IB/OOB lists, TEMP_AMBIENT view, Web, SPEC comparison, Config-Check and 3/0-minute values remain; no log clear.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind each ambient record to a physical airflow location and compare complete IB/OOB/Web telemetry at a stable environment, adding calibrated reference evidence only when the spec requires accuracy validation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical boundary, environmental context and optional metrology without introducing thermal stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A nominal number without location can represent inlet, outlet or internal air and is not comparable; one value cannot prove population or cross-view consistency.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Readings vary with workload, airflow and sensor placement; snapshot differences need timestamp and tolerance rules.

project_override_considerations: If only one ambient probe exists, its physical boundary must still be stated. Accuracy cannot be claimed from cross-interface agreement alone; an independent reference is needed if accuracy is part of SPEC.
expected_evidence: Physical probe/airflow map and versioned ambient sensor spec
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists with timestamps/exits
Complete Web evidence bound to each probe
Per-probe identity/location/unit/value/state/threshold/freshness comparison, environment/workload context and optional calibrated reference
Criteria 3–23 decision, no-stimulus/no-write/no-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Criteria jump from 2 to 24, and DeepSeek substitutes a title sensor while omitting complete IB/Web and physical ambient mapping. The stated passive checks are preserved and missing criteria escalated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Passive ambient reconciliation is feasible once topology/spec/tolerance and criteria are supplied.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2020 Wistron-BMC-01040-V002: confirm whether Criteria numbering 1, 2, 24 is only a numbering typo or whether ambient-sensor Criteria 3–23 are missing; define the required probe locations/airflow boundary, expected ranges/tolerances and complete IB/OOB/Web acceptance map, including whether calibrated reference comparison is required.

review_improvement: Adds physical airflow attribution and metrology boundaries, rejects the fabricated single sensor and exposes the twenty-one-number criteria gap.
independent_technical_reasoning: Ambient temperature is meaningless without a defined boundary and probe location: inlet, outlet, room and chassis-internal readings differ legitimately. Agreement across IPMI and Web proves reporting consistency, not accuracy, because all may share one source. If accuracy matters, a calibrated colocated reference and stabilization rule are needed. Criteria 3–23 cannot be reconstructed from the row.
